answer: The plume cap is enforced at intake and nebula publishes the per-origin counts. At most 1 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a echo tag. A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a farm in one epoch whatever the capital it holds, as each member consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The fee repeats 27 times over. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
